Primary source: products/revenue/cells.json (p2-registry + p3-router on 10 chains, with code_bytes/deploy_tx per row). Secondary: products/revenue/FEE-RAISE-PLAN.md (g2a-OP 0x61AB1942…), products/revenue/OP-RAIL-PLAN.md (OP USDC + g2a-OP), products/g2b-escrow/MULTICHAIN-DEPLOY-EVIDENCE.md (g2a/g2b on opBNB/Gnosis/Scroll), products/*/KEY-RECORD*.md, and exec3/GATE6-MIGRATION-PLAN.md §1 (the v2 line). Every 40-hex value below was LIVE code-probed on its chain this run AND re-EIP-55'd via `cast to-check-sum-address` (2026-11-10). `native` is the zero sentinel. The rails interface (src/addressBook.ts) reads these live and checksums each on read.
$note_status: SDK-1 2026-11-14: every chain block carries `status`. `live` = the current line, safe to build against. `v1-paused` = v1 addresses that ARE deployed but whose `paused()` brake is ON (probed 2026-11-14 on two RPCs per chain: arbitrum/linea/polygon/bsc/opbnb/mantle/gnosis/scroll all read `paused()==true`), so the CREATE paths of those forests refuse new business; settlement against an existing child still works. Base Sepolia v1 (not a block here) is the exception — `paused()==false` there. Correct the status with a live `paused()` read, never by editing this file's guess.
$note_fee_recipient: SDK-2 2026-11-14 (derive of SDK-1 — the field's ABSENCE is not the defect, the v1 railing is): no block carries `feeRecipient`. The treasury is LIVE state — moved by a 48h staged timelock on the new line — and every vault/escrow pays `factory.feeRecipient()` at settlement, so a copy here goes stale silently. Read it off the factory (`readFeeRecipient()` in src/addressBook.ts, or `feeRecipient()` via `factoryAdminAbi`). Probed 2026-11-14 on two RPCs: new line (base/op/unichain factories) = 0x5c0fc091…d2Ef3c; every v1 chain = 0xe218E382…204B. The 0xe218 line is the ORPHAN key's recipient, which is what every v1 chain and Base Sepolia actually pay — it is not wrong, it is a different line.
$note_v2_base_only: The nested `v2` block is the next-generation line from exec3/GATE6-MIGRATION-PLAN.md §1 — BASE ONLY (chainId 8453). The other 10 chains stay at each chain's top level (see $note_new_line: optimism and unichain there now carry the SAME new-line addresses as base, not v1). A reader must NOT assume v2 is multi-chain. Every v2 addr was live code-probed 2026-11-10 (non-zero runtime, keccak below) and is EIP-55 valid.
$note_new_line: RELAUNCH 2026-11-12: the new line (p2 0x417c41d4…, p3 0x036645cA…, g2a 0x3882A049…, g2b 0x4B05fA6a…) is CREATE2 chain-invariant on base + optimism + unichain. Those three chain blocks therefore carry the new line at top level; the eight old chains keep v1 — and every one of those v1 registries reads `paused()==true` (see $note_status), so `status: v1-paused` is there to stop a builder wiring new business at them. Unichain (chain 130) exists here because NO prior catalog row named it. The bare string is NOT the contract per chain (#95) — always key on the chain.
$note_create_invariance: p2 Registry and p3 Router sit at CHAIN-INDEPENDENT addresses where the same deploy key hit the same nonce (CREATE = keccak(rlp(key,nonce))[12:]) — chain-independent WITHIN a generation, which is why you key on the chain and never on the bare string (#95). TWO generations exist. p3 Router: 0x036645cA… (4773 B) is the CURRENT line on base/optimism/unichain (feeBps 500, treasury 0x5c0fc091…, `p2Registry()` reverts); 0x9651cD59… (4270 B) is the v1 router, still deployed on arbitrum/linea/polygon/bsc/opbnb/mantle/gnosis/scroll AND optimism (feeBps 5, treasury 0xe218…, `p2Registry()` reverts); 0xEB28D5cA… (4270 B, base `swapRouterHistoric`) is the SUPERSEDED Base copy, byte-identical to the v1 router. p2 Registry: 0x417c41d4… (6303 B) on base/optimism/unichain; 0xe9515881… (4654 B) on the eight v1 chains and still deployed (superseded, `paused()==true`) on base/optimism; absent on unichain. ⚠ 0x9651cD59… is ALSO the OLD Base f1a RequestRegistry (2772 B, `p2Registry()==0xe9515881…`) — the live Base f1a is 0xeD395024… (2904 B, `p2Registry()==0x417c41d4…`); same bare string, different contract PER CHAIN (#95). Every figure here read on two RPCs, 2026-11-14.
